Case: Patient D is a 29-year-old Asian man metastatic medulloblastoma status-post multiple rounds of chemotherapy and radiation therapy, presenting with several months of progressive leg pain. You obtain a surveillance MRI of his entire spine and discover drop metastases seeding extensive regions of his spinal cord and thecal sac, with multiple lower nerve roots engorged by tumor.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
